independent.derivation: Independently derived values; no upstream token values or prose copied.

rationale: Borders communicate containment; shadows are deliberately absent.
use: Choose for raised surfaces, overlays and modal containers with explicit ordering.
avoid: Do not use shadows as the sole boundary in dark themes or high contrast. Elevation is not z-index and does not escape ancestor stacking contexts.

--ds-elevation-raised.derivation: Original two-lobe geometry increases offset and blur by level; opacity stays below 0.2 per lobe.

--ds-elevation-edge-raised.derivation: A visible edge survives surfaces where black shadows have little contrast.

--ds-elevation-overlay.derivation: Original two-lobe geometry increases offset and blur by level; opacity stays below 0.2 per lobe.

--ds-elevation-edge-overlay.derivation: A visible edge survives surfaces where black shadows have little contrast.

--ds-elevation-modal.derivation: Original two-lobe geometry increases offset and blur by level; opacity stays below 0.2 per lobe.

--ds-elevation-edge-modal.derivation: A visible edge survives surfaces where black shadows have little contrast.

--ds-elevation-edge-color.derivation: Independent middle grey boundary; recheck against adopted surfaces.

guidance: Raised: local cards; overlay: menus/popovers; modal: a dialog container. These values do not supply dialog semantics or focus management.
Native shadow arrays describe intent; platform APIs differ in spread, clipping and multiple-shadow support. Translate and render-test them.
example: .example-overlay { box-shadow: var(--shadow-overlay, none); border: var(--surface-edge-width, 1px) solid var(--surface-edge, #777777); }
